entry.name: SteamLibraryPath
entry.label: Steam workshop path

entry.name: AutoPickSource
entry.label: The WallpaperSource of the last automatic change from outside the plugin (we-manager's playlists and virtual desktops write it just before WallpaperSource): while stopped, it waits for the reload instead of loading like a pick by hand

entry.name: WallpaperWorkShopId
entry.label: Wallpaper workshopid

entry.name: WallpaperSource
entry.label: Wallpaper Source

entry.name: BackgroundColor
entry.label: Backdrop color (visible in Keep Aspect Ratio mode behind aspect-mismatched wallpapers)

entry.name: AccentFromSchemeColor
entry.label: Plasma's accent colour from the wallpaper takes the wallpaper's own scheme colour, when it has one, instead of a colour sampled from the picture

entry.name: DisplayMode
entry.label: Video display mode

entry.name: PauseMode
entry.label: Video Pause mode

entry.name: PauseFilterByScreen
entry.label: Filter By Screen

entry.name: FocusAction
entry.label: What a focused window does, where Pause mode watches focus (0=Keep running, 1=Mute, 2=Pause, 3=Stop and free memory)

entry.name: MaximizedAction
entry.label: What a maximized window does, where Pause mode watches maximized windows (0=Keep running, 1=Mute, 2=Pause, 3=Stop and free memory)

entry.name: FullscreenAction
entry.label: What a fullscreen window does, where Pause mode watches fullscreen windows (0=Keep running, 1=Mute, 2=Pause, 3=Stop and free memory)

entry.name: PauseAction
entry.label: What running on battery does (0=Pause, 1=Stop and free memory)

entry.name: StopScope
entry.label: Which screens a stop unloads (0=This screen, 1=All screens)

entry.name: VramStop
entry.label: Stop when video memory runs out: the wallpaper unloads when the GPU has too little free for 3 seconds, and loads again when there is room for it and a margin (we-manager vram patch)

entry.name: UnloadAfterPausedMin
entry.label: Unload a wallpaper that has been paused this many minutes, and load it again when the pause ends (0=never)

entry.name: PauseDebugLogging
entry.label: Log which window satisfied the pause predicate (console.error, off the hot path)

entry.name: PauseOnBatPower
entry.label: Pause when PC is on battery power

entry.name: PauseBatPercent
entry.label: Pause Battery Percent

entry.name: ScreenSaverPolicy
entry.label: Behaviour when screen is locked / screensaver active (0=Keep running, 1=Pause)

entry.name: SortMode
entry.label: Sort mode

entry.name: VideoBackend
entry.label: Video Backend

entry.name: MuteAudio
entry.label: Mute audio

entry.name: RandomizeWallpaper
entry.label: Randomize every X minutes

entry.name: NoRandomWhilePaused
entry.label: Prevent randomization while wallpapers are paused

entry.name: UserPaused
entry.label: Wallpaper paused by the user (persists across plasmashell restarts)

entry.name: MpvStats
entry.label: Mpv Stats

entry.name: MpvPowerSaving
entry.label: Power-saving video playback: cheap scaling, frames at the video's own rate, capped at the Fps setting

entry.name: MpvInterpolation
entry.label: Smooth video motion: mpv blends frames at the display's refresh rate (interpolation, tscale=oversample); costs GPU time, ignored while power saving is on

entry.name: MpvHwdec
entry.label: Hardware video decoding: video wallpapers (mpv) and video layers in scenes decode on the GPU through VA-API where they can; off decodes on the CPU, for drivers whose video decoding is broken

entry.name: MpvLoadInMemory
entry.label: Load videos into memory: mpv keeps the whole file (up to 1 GiB) in its demuxer cache, so a loop never reads the disk again

entry.name: MpvVideoSync
entry.label: Video timing: 0 the video's own clock (default), 1 retimed to the screen's refresh rate (display-resample), 2 frames dropped or repeated to the screen's refresh rate (display-vdrop); smooth video motion and power saving take precedence

entry.name: VerboseLogging
entry.label: Verbose logging

entry.name: SafeStartAfterCrash
entry.label: Safe start after a crash: a wallpaper that was loading when Plasma stopped (crashed or was killed) less than two minutes earlier is not loaded again at the restart; the screen offers Load anyway

entry.name: ReloadAfterSleep
entry.label: Reload the wallpaper after a suspend or hibernation (3 s after the wake): a fresh backend, as a change of render resolution makes one; a stopped wallpaper, or one held back by safe start, is left as it is; each reload is a line in the journal

entry.name: MouseInput
entry.label: Mouse Input

entry.name: IconOpacity
entry.label: Opacity of the desktop's icons (Folder View) over the wallpaper, in percent; widgets are not faded

entry.name: KeyboardInput
entry.label: Keyboard mode for web wallpapers: the "Give the keyboard to the web wallpaper" shortcut hands the desktop's keys to the page until Escape

entry.name: SceneOptions
entry.label: Marker, never read: this build takes the per-wallpaper scene options mouse_parallax and pixel_art from each wallpaper's settings file; tools tell it from other builds by this entry

entry.name: AnimatedPreview
entry.label: Animated Preview

entry.name: Fps
entry.label: Fps

entry.name: RenderScale
entry.label: Percentage of the display resolution to render at; Qt upscales the result

entry.name: TextureQuality
entry.label: Texture resolution of scene wallpapers: 0 = full, 1 = performance (one mip level less: half the size, a quarter of the memory), 2 = automatic (no larger than the screen); textures without mipmaps, sprite sheets and video textures stay as they are

entry.name: MsaaMode
entry.label: Anti-aliasing sample count: 0 = automatic, 1 = off, 2 = 2x, 4 = 4x

entry.name: ProcessPriority
entry.label: CPU priority of the scene renderer's threads: 0 = normal, 1 = below normal (nice 5), 2 = low (nice 10); low also asks the GPU for a low-priority queue where the driver offers one

entry.name: PresentMode
entry.label: Swapchain present mode policy (0=Auto, 1=Fifo, 2=FifoRelaxed, 3=Mailbox, 4=Immediate)

entry.name: SwitchTimer
entry.label: Change timer (in minutes)

entry.name: ResumeTime
entry.label: Resume time from paused (in ms)

entry.name: Volume
entry.label: Volume

entry.name: Speed
entry.label: Playback speed

entry.name: FilterStr
entry.label: FilterStr

entry.name: WallpaperLanguage
entry.label: Language handed to wallpapers (Wallpaper Engine code such as de-de or zh-chs); empty: Plasma's language

entry.name: PerOptChanged
entry.label: PerOptChanged

entry.name: CustomConf
entry.label: CustomConf

entry.name: HdrOutput
entry.label: HDR Output

entry.name: PostProcessing
entry.label: Post-processing level for wallpapers without their own (empty=the scene's own, off=no bloom, low, medium, ultra=HDR mip-chain bloom)

entry.name: PostProcessingLevels
entry.label: Marker, never read: in this build PostProcessing and each wallpaper's postprocessing take the levels above; tools tell it from other builds by this entry

entry.name: SystemAudioCapture
entry.label: System Audio Capture

entry.name: AudioConfigFile
entry.label: Marker, never read: this build takes the audio capture source, sensitivity, noise floor, attack and decay from ~/.config/wekde/audio.json (one file for every screen), reloaded by the ReloadAudioConfig D-Bus method; tools tell it from other builds by this entry

entry.name: MediaIntegration
entry.label: Media integration: scene and web wallpapers get the media player's title, artist, album, cover, playback state and position over MPRIS

entry.name: VideoFolderPath
entry.label: Plain video wallpapers folder

entry.name: ActivePlaylistId
entry.label: Active playlist id (empty=none, __filtered_library__=built-in)

entry.name: CurrentItemIndex
entry.label: Cycle position within the active playlist

entry.name: PlaylistsReloadSeq
entry.label: Bumped by the config dialog after every playlist CRUD so the runtime mgr re-reads playlists.json without a plasmashell restart.

entry.name: PlaylistNotifyOnAdvance
entry.label: Show tray notification when playlist advances

entry.name: CacheQuotaMB
entry.label: Cache disk quota (MB; 0 = unlimited)
